rationale: The redesign adds NEW surface area not covered by any existing spec: (1) the GeneralSettings description textarea + 'Save changes' label + footer/helper copy (dashboard-general-setting.spec.js only covers name/dynamic-filter/time + add-tab), (2) the per-variable dependency-count chip and the no-variables OEmptyState (variables specs cover add/save/delete and dependency *reload* behavior, not the chip or empty state), and (3) the tab panel-count badge (dashboard-tabs-setting.spec.js covers tab add/rename/delete in the settings drawer, not the view-header badge). These span three existing specs, so cramming them via append would scatter one coherent redesign across three files. The run-context names a dedicated spec (dashboardSettings.spec.js, group Dashboards-Settings) whose group already exists in ci_matrix.json. The scheduled-reports empty state is ALREADY covered by Reports/scheduledReportsDrawer.spec.js (P2 + filtered search), so it is NOT re-tested — only its filtered empty-state variant is noted as a minor gap. The grid drag/resize backdrop is cosmetic with no data-test and is parked.
